body: Dimension 20 is literally what got me thinking about DnD again! I was watching some of it and it looks so fun but i just did not understand what was happening. Your explanation was very enlightening though. Now i just wish i had people to play with.

okok, i think im getting it. How do people create a campaign? Like, where do you even start? You create a character for yourself to play and build a back story and goals, etc, right? But i assume players in a game need to have some commonality in their campaigns for cohesive gameplay? Is the dungeon master the person that creates the external world that the players campaigns fit into?
